changes_made.explanation: Removed all tasks except Visual Question Generation, which is the main focus of the paper. The other tasks are only mentioned as examples of potential applications but not actually evaluated.
Normalized metric names to standard forms and removed duplicates. Consolidated perplexity variants under 'Perplexity' since they refer to the same metric type.
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The paper uses LLMs (GPT-2) for truncation during generation, not for evaluation.

guideline: Pairwise comparison of question samples produced by different models
Participants select the better question according to four criteria: language quality, language grounding, language originality and diversity, and syntax errors
- Pairwise comparison of question samples according to four criteria: language quality, language grounding, language originality and diversity, and syntax errors.
Pairwise comparison of question samples produced by two models, asking participants to select the better one according to each criterion.
The study is based on pairwise comparison of question samples produced by the concurrent algorithms according to four criteria.

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated redundant guideline descriptions and normalized criteria names to consistent title case. Removed duplicate criteria variants.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on Visual Question Generation using the TrufLL method. The extraction was generally good but included many tasks that were only mentioned as examples rather than actually evaluated. The automatic metrics extraction was comprehensive but needed normalization. Human evaluation was well-documented with clear criteria.
